videos.title: A Royal Montana Christmas
videos.description: Princess Victoria is ready for a change of pace. Looking to decompress, she decides to take a vacation to Peaceful Pines Ranch in Montana.

videos.title: Christmas In Maple Hills
videos.description: Valerie teams up with a dashing veteran to track down the original owner of her father's land to preserve the legacy of her family. Festive romance.

videos.title: A Make Or Break Holiday
videos.description: A couple hosting Christmas decides to fake their relationship after choosing to separate. Working together for the holiday helps them remember why they fell in love.

videos.title: The Christmas Quest
videos.description: When an archaeologist begins a search for an ancient Christmas treasure, she must team up with her ex-husband - who is an expert in Nordic languages - to find it.

videos.title: Holiday Unplugged
videos.description: A screen-free Christmas helps Sally reconnect with her family and find new love, as they learn to cherish old memories and make new ones.

videos.title: Christmas On Call
videos.description: The lives of various first responders in Philadelphia intersect over the holiday season while juggling work, personal lives and their dedication to protect and serve their city.

videos.title: Holiday Touchdown: A Bills Love Story
videos.description: Sparks fly between two lifelong Buffalo Bills fans as they try to discover the identity of a mysterious Christmas gift-giver.

videos.title: Hanukkah on the Rocks
videos.description: An lawyer embarks on a journey to find Hanukkah candles, leading her to a Chicago bar where she transforms the holiday spirit and finds the courage to pursue a new path.

videos.title: To Have And To Holiday
videos.description: Celeste and Jason get engaged and ask her pastor father - who's not ready to let his daughter go - to officiate their Christmas wedding.

videos.title: Tidings For The Season
videos.description: A serious TV newscaster's life changes when he meets his young superfan and the boy's hardworking single mum, but a career opportunity forces him to choose between ambition and love.

videos.title: The More The Merrier
videos.description: Alice, an ER doctor, volunteers to work Christmas Eve. During a snowy Christmas, Alice and Brian, a top-rated cardiologist, help deliver three baby booms, sparking a lasting bond.

videos.title: A Novel Noel
videos.description: A book editor takes on a temporary gig running a bookstore, where her battles with the owner's son allow her to rediscover her passion for nurturing creativity.

videos.title: An Ice Palace Romance
videos.description: After a journalist returns to her hometown ice rink to cover a story, the rink's owner melts her heart.

videos.title: A Christmas Less Travelled
videos.description: An old audio cassette of her dad's voice sends a woman on a journey to retrace her family's most memorable moments at Christmastime.

videos.title: Deck The Walls
videos.description: Interior designer, Rose DeMonte, uses her skills back in her hometown to renovate a Christmas Charity Home for her brother Sal and his contractor Brysen's home flipping company.

videos.title: Sugarplummed
videos.description: When Emily wishes for a perfect Christmas like the ones found in the popular Sugarplum movies, she's shocked when Sugarplum herself appears to help her fulfil it.

videos.title: She's Making A List
videos.description: A naughty-or-nice inspector falls for a widowed father while evaluating his daughter, forcing her to choose between duty and love.

videos.title: Everything Christmas
videos.description: Christmas enthusiast Lori-Jo embarks on an epic three-day road trip with her workaholic best friend to the town where it's Christmas all year round.

videos.title: A Make Or Break Holiday
videos.description: A couple hosting Christmas decides to fake their relationship after choosing to separate. Working together for the holiday helps them remember why they fell in love.

videos.title: The Christmas Quest
videos.description: When an archaeologist begins a search for an ancient Christmas treasure, she must team up with her ex-husband - who is an expert in Nordic languages - to find it.

videos.title: A Royal Montana Christmas
videos.description: Princess Victoria is ready for a change of pace. Looking to decompress, she decides to take a vacation to Peaceful Pines Ranch in Montana.

videos.title: A Very Vermont Christmas
videos.description: A local champion skier and Vermont brew master teams up with an unlikely match to create a seasonal microbrew to save her family's business before Christmas.

videos.title: Season's Greetings From...
videos.description: Across three different eras, different families occupy a family home, leaving their own festive mark throughout the years despite life's challenges.

videos.title: Magic In Mistletoe
videos.description: After best-selling author Harrington's social media comments ruffle feathers, publicist April's damage control plan means spending Christmas together.

videos.title: Mistletoe In Montana
videos.description: Cowgirl Merry has been unlucky in love, but is she right to hope that her fortunes have changed when single dad Mark gallops onto her ranch and lassoes her heart.

videos.title: Trading Up Christmas
videos.description: Keri desperately needs a new home and her sister Michelle hatches a plan to help. With only a Christmas stocking, she sets out to trade her way up to something far greater-a house.

videos.title: A Christmas Intern
videos.description: Newly retired Cecelia visits her daughter, Alexis, who owns an online gift-giving business and becomes an intern. Together, they learn the meaning of Christmas, one gift at a time.

videos.title: Saving The Christmas Ranch
videos.description: When the accountant for Carrie's family's Christmas lodge makes off with all of their money, Carrie has just two days to come up with nine months of missing mortgage payments.

videos.title: Designing Christmas With You
videos.description: With her career on the line, a decorator must work with an unexpected partner to showcase a house for an upcoming Christmas gala.

videos.title: A Merry Scottish Christmas
videos.description: When estranged siblings Lindsay and Brad travel to Scotland at Christmas to reunite with their mother, a big family secret is revealed.
